ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the route did go wrong, and the money follows the arithmetic rather than either party's recollection of it.

The deviation is established under POL-RD-01. The governing figure is the GPS trace distance of 27.18 km (EV-GPS-00101), not the trip record's rounded 27.2 km, which POL-RD-01 says may not be cited for the threshold test. Against the 21.0 km optimal route that is an excess of 6.18 km, or 29.43% — passing both establishment tests (over 0.8 km and over 20%). It is below the materiality markers (50% of optimal and 8.0 km absolute), so this is a non-material deviation: no FULL_REFUND of the charge and no POL-RD-06 uplift. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (EV-GPS-00101: 229 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps, 10 s sampling, all inside POL-RD-07(a)–(c)), so it alone carries the finding; the driver's chat message 'sorry boss missed the exit' (EV-CHAT-00101) and his formal statement that he took a wrong turn at the MCE exit confirm the cause independently in any event.

No exculpatory clause applies. There was no rider detour instruction (POL-RD-04 — every chat waypoint_hint is null, so nothing to act on), no endpoint amendment (POL-RD-05 — all amendment fields null), no pooled itinerary (POL-RD-12 — vehicle_type RYDE_X, solo optimal null), no upfront quote (fare_model is METERED), and no traffic advisory: EV-ADVIS-00101-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 can excuse no part of the excess.

The refund is fixed by POL-RD-02. charged_total is 35.64; recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 21.0 + 0.28 x 26.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = 27.63; refund = 35.64 - 27.63 = 8.01, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 8.05. That is 22.5% of the charge — far below the 90% full-refund share and well above the 0.50 de minimis. The rider claimed a 10.00 difference; the record allows 8.05, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top: the fare breakdown carries no ERP, toll or airport-surcharge lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00), so there is no pass-through correction and no double count. Driver compensation under POL-RD-04 does not arise — the rider was billed 27.2 km, slightly MORE than the 27.18 km driven, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall. The driver profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 against 812 completed trips, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is warranted; there is no phantom charge line, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral either. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires.

Confidence is capped at 1.0 and set at 0.95: every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-GPS-00101, EV-TRIP-00101, EV-FARE-00101 and EV-CHAT-00101 — carries weight 1.0, and the one impaired artifact in the pool (EV-ADVIS-00101-01, weight 0.0) is not relied on for any finding.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider and the driver: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00103, weight 1.0, unbroken 175 fixes at 10 s) measures 11.18 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a booked optimal of 8.2 km (EV-TRIP-00103) — an excess of 2.98 km, or 36.34%. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so a route deviation is established on this trip's own trace; it is not a MATERIAL deviation (both figures sit under the 50% and 8.0 km thresholds). The deviation is nevertheless fully exonerated under POL-RD-03. The LTA DataMall advisory EV-ADVIS-00103-01 (weight 1.0) closes Braddell Road (towards Serangoon) between Lorong 1 Toa Payoh and Bishan Rd from 05:30 to 12:00, a road the booked optimal route itself uses, and its window overlaps the 08:07–08:36 trip. The POL-RD-03 cap is min(2.98 km, 1.30 x (10.6 - 8.2) + 1.00 = 4.12 km) = 2.98 km, so the whole excess is justified and the distance-time charges stand; POL-RD-02 therefore does not run in either direction, and no distance refund is owed. What the closure does not do is put the CTE gantries on the rider's route. The booked optimal route carries $0.00 of ERP (trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00), while the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00103, weight 1.0) itemises $4.00 of off-route ERP — CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) $3.00 and CTE (Moulmein Rd towards City) $1.00, both flagged on_optimal_route false, against an on-optimal-route total of $0.00. Under POL-RD-09(2) those off-route charges are refunded to the rider as a standalone pass-through correction because the rider did not cause the closure either; the $4.00 is well under the $12.00 per-trip cap. Both gantries are genuine crossings — the nearest trace fixes are 0.0 m and 40.25 m away, inside the 250 m match radius — so POL-RD-09(4) yields no phantom-line finding and no billing-integrity referral. The $4.00 is refunded once only: because POL-RD-03 fully excuses the deviation, POL-RD-02 does not also run, so there is no double count under POL-RD-09(1). On the parties' arguments: the rider's claims that the deviation is established and that the $4.00 is off-route ERP are accepted; the driver's claims that the closure exonerates the distance and time lines, that the two gantries are real, and that the rider's only recovery is the capped pass-through are also accepted, and both advocates arrive at the same $4.00 figure under POL-RD-09(2). The rider's claim that POL-RD-04 is unavailable is accepted — the driver's message announced the CTE route and the rider's 'ok' is an acknowledgement, not a rider instruction, and it carries no waypoint_hint, so the clause cannot run and POL-RD-09(3) does not bar the ERP refund. The driver's alternative figure of $4.15 (a POL-RD-02 recomputation against the closure-adjusted 11.18 km optimal) is noted but does not displace the primary route, because POL-RD-03 leaves nothing unexonerated for POL-RD-02 to refund. No repeat-deviation pattern is established (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d 0 against completed_trips_90d 553), so POL-RD-06 produces neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor a conduct referral; and the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07 (no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0), so POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. Confidence rests on artifacts all at weight 1.0, giving a cap of 1.0. Of the $9.00 contested, $4.00 is refunded to the rider and the balance of $5.00 remains payable.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

This was a $29.91 RYDE_PLUS trip from Woodlands to ION Orchard on 19 July 2026. The rider says the driver should have taken the BKE and instead went via Upper Thomson and Mandai, taking 32 minutes instead of 27, and asks for $7.00 back. The claim is not supported by the evidence, and the fare stands.

The governing test is POL-RD-01. The route actually driven, measured from the GPS trace, is 21.79 km (EV-GPS-00102, the governing field trace_distance_km; the 21.8 km on the trip record is the rounded copy the clause forbids citing for the threshold test). The platform's optimal route is 20.4 km (EV-TRIP-00102). The excess is 1.39 km, or 6.81% of optimal. POL-RD-01 makes a deviation established only where the excess is both more than 0.8 km in absolute terms AND more than 20% of optimal. The 0.8 km limb is cleared; the 20% limb is not, by a wide margin. Where either test fails the clause says no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. A real but small difference in route length is a route preference, not a refundable deviation.

On the driver's explanation: the in-app message ('boss BKE quite jam, i go Upper Bukit Timah ok?') and the statement that the BKE was slow near Dairy Farm explain the route choice but are a general assertion about traffic that cites no evidence, and under POL-RD-08 such an assertion carries no weight. No exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing artifact: the driver does not put POL-RD-03 forward. I note that the LTA traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00102-01) is absent from the record — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — so no POL-RD-03 exoneration could have been run in any event; but that absence does not require escalation here, because the case never reaches exoneration at all. It is decided at the POL-RD-01 gate on clean evidence, and it would be wrong to escalate a dispute the gate resolves.

On the money: the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00102) reconciles to the cent at $29.91 for 21.8 km and 32.0 billed minutes, surge_multiplier 1.0 read from the fare breakdown, no ERP, no tolls, no airport surcharge. No charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace or the trip record, so there is no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity correction available whether or not a deviation exists. The rider was billed 21.8 km against a trace of 21.79 km, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall and no POL-RD-04 driver compensation. Even on the platform's own hypothetical POL-RD-02 recomputation the entire difference between the $29.91 charged and a recomputed fare of $27.46 would be $2.45, not $7.00 — and that computation is never reached, because no deviation is established.

No repeat-deviation pattern applies: the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 640 completed trips in 90 days, and the excess is not a material deviation (neither above 50% of optimal nor above 8.0 km), so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows. No other clause in this category produces a referral on these facts.

Outcome: NO_ACTION. Under POL-GEN-03 this is party-relative: on a rider-filed dispute it leaves the present state exactly as it stands — payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd $0.00 are unchanged. Confidence is 0.95, below the 1.0 cap set by the unimpaired weight-1.0 GPS trace and trip record that carry the deciding measurement.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver, this is what the evidence shows and how the money was worked out.

WHAT HAPPENED. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00104) puts the trip at 34.17 km. That is the figure POL-RD-01 makes govern, not the rounded 34.2 km copy on the trip record, so your '34 km', rider, is measured at 34.17 km. The booked optimal route was 27.1 km (PIE westbound throughout). The excess is therefore 7.07 km, or 26.09% of the optimal. Because that is above both the 20% and the 0.8 km gates, a route deviation IS established on the trip as driven. The rider's core complaint is not dismissed.

WHY MOST OF IT IS EXCUSED. The driver is substantially right about the accident. The LTA DataMall advisory ADV-20260716-007 (EV-ADVIS-00104-01) names the PIE towards Tuas after the Eunos Link exit - the very road the booked optimal route uses - was valid from 20:02 to 21:35 (covering the 20:35-21:22 trip window), and the trace shows the vehicle quitting the PIE at Bedok North Ave 4 before the blocked stretch and rejoining on the AYE. All three limbs of POL-RD-03 are met, so the diversion is exonerated - but the exoneration is capped. The cap is min(7.07, 1.30 x (30.1 - 27.1) + 1.00) = 4.90 km. So 4.90 km is excused and 2.17 km is not.

THE DRIVER'S 'NO REFUND AT ALL' ARGUMENT IS REJECTED. The driver contends that because the residual 2.17 km is only 6.8% of the closure-adjusted optimal, the establishment test fails and the outcome must be NO_ACTION. That is not the structure of the policy. Establishment under POL-RD-01 is measured on the trip as driven against the booked optimal, and POL-RD-02 expressly directs that where POL-RD-03 excuses PART of the excess the recomputation runs against the closure-adjusted optimal - a direction that has no work to do if partial exoneration could annihilate the deviation altogether. A driver who drives beyond even the generous lawful-alternative cap is charged for the excess.

THE ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02). Closure-adjusted optimal = 27.1 + 4.90 = 32.00 km, duration 34.0 x (32.00/27.1) = 40.1 min. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 32.00 + 0.28 x 40.1) x 1.0 surge (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 39.828. charged_total = 43.41. Refund = 43.41 - 39.828 = 3.582, rounded UP to SGD 3.60. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below the 90% full-refund share, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.60. The rider's figure of about $14.00 is traceable to no artifact: even setting the accident aside entirely the arithmetic gives only $9.00, and with the accident excused it is $3.60.

THE OTHER POINTS. (1) The chat log (EV-CHAT-00104) does not make this a rider-requested detour: the driver announced the ECP diversion and the rider merely answered 'ok but not too long ah'; the rider named no road or place and waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and nothing is excluded on that ground. (2) The second advisory, EV-ADVIS-00104-02 (the claimed CTE breakdown), is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.25 with issue codes ADVISORY_UNCORROBORATED and UNVERIFIED_SOURCE, covers a CTE corridor the trace never enters, and exonerates nothing; it is discarded on the merits and no part of this ruling rests on it. (3) The residual 2.17 km is well below both the 8.0 km and 50% materiality gates, so the deviation is not MATERIAL, the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged, and no driver-conduct referral arises; the driver's deviation_flags_90d of 1 against 288 completed trips would not establish a pattern in any event. (4) The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d 1, substantiated 1) does not trigger the extra corroboration requirement under POL-RD-08. (5) The fare was CHARGED with no refund issued, so the present state stands only as to the unrefunded portion; the driver is not owed any compensation, as the billed distance (34.2 km) is not less than the traced distance.

No clause produces a referral, and no escalation trigger under POL-RD-10 fires: the trace is unimpaired by POL-RD-07 (283 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps), the trip identifiers all match, and the deciding artifacts carry full weight 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To both parties: this is a route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-00106 (Toa Payoh Central to Bugis Junction). The ruling is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75 to the rider.

DEVIATION (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 10.78 km (EV-GPS-00106); the trip record's rounded 10.8 km may not be cited for the threshold test. Against the platform optimal of 7.2 km (EV-TRIP-00106) the excess is 3.58 km = 49.72%, clearing both establishment gates (above 20% and above 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is NOT MATERIAL: 49.72% is not greater than the 50% line and 3.58 km is not greater than 8.0 km. The trip record's 50.0% is computed from the rounded 10.8 km copy and is not the governing reading.

TRACE INTEGRITY (POL-RD-07). The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 169 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gap over 90 seconds, no jump over 500 m, maximum gap 0.0 s. The deviation therefore stands on the trace alone and needs no independent corroboration.

EXONERATION. No exculpatory clause applies. No traffic advisory covers the corridor: EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — disclosed as POL-GEN-02 requires. Its absence is citable and confirms no closure exoneration, but it carries no deciding fact and does not move the confidence cap. The single chat message (EV-CHAT-00106, 08:46:30, 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us') is a complaint in progress, not a rider instruction, and waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run. There is no endpoint amendment (POL-RD-05), and vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12).

REMEDY (POL-RD-02). fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance-and-time refund and POL-RD-02 runs. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 + 0.28 x 19) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-00106) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 optimal-route ERP = 15.32. Refund = charged_total 26.04 less 15.32 = 10.72, rounded UP to 10.75. That is 41.2% of the charge, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND and the rider's demand for the full 26.04 is not reachable.

ERP (POL-RD-09). The 5.50 of off-route ERP (CTE Braddell Rd 3.00 + CTE Chin Swee Rd tunnel 2.50) is already comprehended inside the 10.75, because the recomputed fare includes only gantries lying on the optimal route and that route carries none (optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00). It is itemised for transparency and must never be added on top; both the 26.04 figure and a 10.75 + 5.50 = 16.25 variant double-count. POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged: both gantries are genuinely crossed (nearest fixes 0.0 m and 24.1 m, inside the 250 m match radius), so there is no phantom line and no billing-integrity referral.

REPEAT PATTERN (POL-RD-06). driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 96 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established; the FULL_REFUND uplift of limb (b) and the conduct referral of limb (c) do not arise.

DRIVER COMPENSATION. Null. The distance billed (10.8 km) is not less than the trace distance (10.78 km), so there is no unbilled kilometre and POL-RD-04's compensation limb does not fire.

ESCALATION (POL-RD-10). No trigger fires: identifiers match across trip record, trace and fare breakdown; the trace is unimpaired; timestamps are consistent; every charge line has a counterpart in the trace; and the refund is far below the ceiling.

REFERRALS: none — no clause produces one on these facts. Confidence is 0.92, capped by the weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-00106, EV-TRIP-00106, EV-FARE-00106) that carry the deciding facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Rider: the route deviation is established and material on your own trip's evidence. Under POL-RD-01 the governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 54.16 km (the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 54.2 km may not be used for the threshold test) against the booked optimal of 36.0 km — an excess of 18.16 km, or 50.44% of optimal. Both establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km) and both materiality gates (over 50% and over 8.0 km) are cleared. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 427 fixes, a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, zero gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged. Nothing reduces the baseline: there is no POL-RD-05 amendment and POL-RD-04 is unavailable because no rider message contains a waypoint_hint or names an actionable road.

Driver: your explanation — 'traffic was heavy on the PIE' — is an assertion that cites no evidence and names no artifact. It therefore carries no weight and does not discharge the burden that shifted to you under POL-RD-08, and it is discarded. POL-RD-03 cannot run: EV-ADVIS-00105-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload) and no LTA advisory covers the PIE eastbound in the disputed window, so nothing exonerates the excess. This is also not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation: you invoked no exculpatory clause against a cited-but-missing artifact — you named no artifact at all — so the uncited assertion is disposed of under POL-RD-08 and the case is decided on the record rather than sent to a reviewer. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers all match (TRP-00105) across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, the timestamps run forward, the trace is unimpaired, and the refund is well below the SGD 150.00 ceiling.

The money. POL-RD-02 on the METERED fare: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 36.0 optimal km + 0.28 x 42.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP/tolls + 0.00 chargeable surcharge - 0.00 promo = 43.36. The POL-RD-02 refund is charged_total 65.13 - recomputed_fare 43.36 = 21.77, rounded up to SGD 21.80, which is 33.4% of the charge and therefore a partial, not a full, refund on that clause alone.

POL-RD-06. Because the deviation is MATERIAL, the driver_profile check is mandatory. On driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d = 4 (threshold 3) a repeat deviation pattern is ESTABLISHED. EV-DPROF-00105 is IMPAIRED — issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT, weight 0.75 (snapshot 108 hours old against a 72-hour threshold) — and I say so on the face of this ruling: the finding survives the discount because 4 flags clear a threshold of 3, but this ruling's confidence is capped at 0.75 by that artifact, which is the sole carrier of the pattern fact. No other profile field is used (POL-GEN-01); in particular the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is not the field POL-RD-06 names. Because the deviation is both material and substantiated on this trip's own evidence, POL-RD-06(b) replaces the POL-RD-02 partial with FULL_REFUND of charged_total: the POL-RD-02 figure is 21.80 and the uplifted figure is 65.13, stated side by side so the size of the uplift is auditable. There are no pass-through lines to settle separately under POL-RD-09 (ERP 0.00; the airport surcharge is 0.00 and correctly so, because this trip ends at, and does not originate at, the airport — no billing-integrity defect). POL-RD-06(c) additionally refers the case to driver-conduct review; that is a referral, not an escalation, and it does not hold up the money.

Your demand for the entire fare, rider, is granted — but through the POL-RD-06(b) uplift, not through the POL-RD-02 arithmetic, which reaches only 21.80. And your point, driver, that POL-RD-02 caps the distance-and-time recovery at 21.80 is correct: the additional recovery comes from the pattern clause, whose only carrier is the impaired profile at weight 0.75, which caps confidence at 0.75.

Amounts: charged_total 65.13; recomputed_fare 43.36; POL-RD-02 refund 21.77, rounded to 21.80; full refund under POL-RD-06(b) 65.13. Driver compensation is nil — the billed distance (54.2 km) is not less than the trace (54.16 km), so POL-RD-04's compensation limb does not apply.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. Trip TRP-00107, 18 July 2026, Ang Mo Kio to Raffles Place. The deviation is ESTABLISHED. POL-RD-01 measures the actual distance on the GPS trace and the optimal on the trip record. EV-GPS-00107 gives a trace distance of 17.57 km; EV-TRIP-00107 gives an optimal of 14.00 km. The excess is 3.57 km, 25.5% of optimal. That clears both establishment gates (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so a deviation exists. It is below both materiality gates (8.0 km and 50%), so this is an ordinary deviation and POL-RD-06's uplift to a full refund does not apply. The GPS trace and the confidence cap. EV-GPS-00107 is IMPAIRED at the admissibility layer — weight 0.30, issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the Raffles Place final approach) — but it is NOT impaired for policy under POL-RD-07: no gap over 90 s (max gap 0.0 s), no jump over 500 m, no sustained sampling interval over 30 s. I say both things, as the clause requires. The 0.30 weight bears on confidence only. The finding survives that discount: the route is carried independently by the chat log EV-CHAT-00107 (weight 1.0), which records the rider putting the Whitley exit to the driver and the driver not denying it, and by the driver's own counterparty statement ("I went by Newton and Kim Seng"). Under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is the higher of the independent carriers — 1.0 — not the 0.30 of the down-weighted trace alone; bundle_integrity_score is context and is not the cap. The driver's traffic excuse does not exonerate him. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic advisory naming the affected corridor with an overlapping validity window. There is none: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE that evening. "CTE very jam tonight boss" is a general assertion unsupported by any advisory ID; under POL-RD-08 it does not discharge the driver's burden and sets aside no part of the excess. POL-RD-04 does not apply either: the only rider message challenges the detour rather than requesting one, and both messages carry waypoint_hint null, so the clause's corroboration test could not be run. The refund. EV-FARE-00107 shows fare_model METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs and the upfront-fare clause POL-RD-11 has no application. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 14.00 + 0.28 × 24.0) × 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177, using the surge_multiplier 1.35 read from the fare breakdown. Charged_total = 36.60. Refund = 36.60 − 29.177 = 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% full-refund share. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: the fare carries no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge, so the 7.45 is the whole of the recovery and no pass-through correction is double-counted. No driver compensation is due, the billed distance not being less than the trace. Profile. ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer. No refund is issued and no charge is confirmed while that review is pending; the disputed $34.42 is held rather than collected or refunded.

THE MEASUREMENT PROBLEM. The only distance measurement in the bundle is the driver-side GPS trace, EV-GPS-00110. It contains a single 428-second gap between consecutive fixes (18:35:00 to 18:42:08), bounded by fixes 6.90 km apart, and that gap covers exactly the KPE stretch in dispute. That is far over POL-RD-07's 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired FOR POLICY PURPOSES, not merely flagged by the admissibility pre-pass (which also records LOW_COVERAGE at 81.7%). Its weight is 0.39 and its issue codes are GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE. Full disclosure under POL-GEN-02: a ruling resting on this figure cannot exceed 0.39, and that is below the 0.70 platform floor, so POL-RD-10(1) fires as well.

WHY NO_ACTION CANNOT ISSUE. Measured the POL-RD-07(i) way - the straight line between the bounding fixes, the reading most favourable to the driver - the trip is 21.20 km against the 18.40 km optimal on EV-TRIP-00110: an excess of 2.80 km, or 15.2%, under POL-RD-01's 20% (3.68 km) and 0.8 km gates. The driver's arithmetic on that reading is correct. But 21.20 km is a floor across a stretch the trace cannot see, not a measurement of it: a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km and over the gate, and nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings. Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) and no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists, POL-RD-07(iii) is explicit that the claim is not sustained AND that the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION - the absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that mandatory.

WHY THERE IS NO CORROBORATION. I checked each POL-RD-07(ii) source. EV-CHAT-00110 contains no driver admission; it is itself impaired (weight 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) and ends at 18:26:14, 2186 seconds before the trip ended, so anything said inside the tunnel is simply absent. EV-FARE-00110's erp_gantries is null, so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. EV-TRIP-00110's actual_distance_km of 21.20 is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as circular. The driver's counterparty statement ('I took the KPE like always') admits the KPE, but the KPE is on the booked optimal corridor ('KPE then ECP'), so it does not place the vehicle off it.

THE DRIVER'S POINTS. The no-deviation calculation (2.80 km / 15.2%) is accepted as the pro-driver reading but cannot be converted into NO_ACTION, for the reason above. The 'optimal corridor' point is accepted as far as it goes - the driver did take the KPE - but the record does not show what happened between the two portals. The chat exchange ('going KPE ah boss' / 'ok') is accepted: the rider answered and did not object, but the thread is truncated and says nothing about the disputed segment. The ERP point is accepted: the $3.00 ERP (optimal_route_erp_sgd 3.00) sits on the optimal route, and with erp_gantries null the POL-RD-09(4) match is undecidable, so the line is treated as matched and no billing-integrity refund arises. The POL-RD-06 point is accepted: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed trips, no repeat pattern is established, and neither an uplift nor a conduct referral follows. The POL-GEN-03 point is not reached: escalation replaces the ruling, so payment_status (CHARGED) and refund_issued_sgd (0.00) are left as they are by the hold rather than by a NO_ACTION.

THE RIDER'S POINTS. The impairment of the trace under POL-RD-07(a) is accepted. The absence of any POL-RD-07(ii) corroborating source is accepted, and it is what drives the escalation. POL-RD-05 does not apply: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so the booked 18.40 km optimal governs and no excess is excluded on that ground. The rider-profile point is accepted: deviation_claims_60d of 1 with 0 substantiated does not engage POL-RD-08's enhanced corroboration. The POL-GEN-02(2) cap of 0.39 and the automatic escalation it triggers are accepted.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. A GPS trace with no tunnel dropout over the disputed stretch, an itemised erp_gantries list for TRP-00110, or a driver admission / independent distance measurement of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names.

REFERRALS. None. POL-RD-06(c) does not fire (no pattern on this driver's trailing-90-day figures) and POL-RD-09(4) does not fire (the $3.00 ERP line is treated as matched, not phantom).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider and the driver: the GPS trace for TRP-00109 is clean — 207 fixes at 10-second intervals, 100% coverage, no gaps — and the trip record, trace and fare breakdown all carry the same trip ID and the same 18:21:10 start, so the trip itself is not in doubt. On the raw figures the vehicle drove 13.76 km (the trace figure, which POL-RD-01 makes governing) against a booked optimal of 6.4 km, an excess of 7.36 km / 115%, material on its face.

The rider's refund claim fails, and the driver is right about why. The chat log carries the rider's own message MSG-00109-001 at 18:22:06 — 'hi can stop at jurong point first? need to grab something 5 min' — resolved by the platform to the Jurong Point PHV Pickup Point waypoint, and the driver accepted 25 seconds later. The GPS trace corroborates it: the vehicle was stationary 38 m from that waypoint for 366 seconds, inside the 200 m radius POL-RD-04 requires, and its furthest point from the start (7,086 m) is consistent with reaching Jurong Point. Jurong Point sits roughly 7 km west of the Clementi–Bukit Batok optimal corridor, so the requested stop is what produced the excess; POL-RD-04 excludes that stretch before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 run, no residual deviation survives the exclusion, and the rider's $21.32 charge stands (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The rider's argument that the record contains no measured post-exclusion excess is rejected: the requested stop is a westward excursion off the whole optimal corridor, and it accounts for the excess. The $8.00 recomputed-fare figure the rider's advocate cites would only arise if the deviation stood; it does not, so no partial refund is due.

The driver is owed money. The fare breakdown bills distance_charged_km 9.6 against the trace's 13.76 km — 4.16 km unbilled, above the 1.0 km gate in POL-RD-04's compensation limb. At $0.75 per unbilled kilometre that is $3.12, rounded up to $3.15, inside the $15.00 per-trip cap. The platform's own assessment of the fare artifact treats this shortfall as a substantive POL-RD-04 finding rather than a cross-source conflict, and it is the figure this ruling moves.

The POL-RD-06 check is clean: deviation_flags_90d is 0 over completed_trips_90d of 511, so no repeat pattern, no full-refund uplift and no conduct referral follow — the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is not the field the clause names and was not used. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: ERP totals 0.00, there are no tolls, no airport surcharge and no promo or waiting-time lines, so there is no pass-through correction. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00109-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) and provides no closure exoneration, but none is needed on this record. Every artifact carrying this ruling — the trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown — is at weight 1.0, so the confidence is not discounted.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider and the driver: the trip's own telemetry shows the route really was longer than booked. EV-GPS-00111 records 29.98 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a booked optimal of 24.0 km — an excess of 5.98 km, 24.9%, past both POL-RD-01 gates (0.8 km and 20%). I use the trace figure, which governs, not the rounded 30.0 km convenience copy on EV-TRIP-00111. The threshold is therefore made out and the burden shifts to the driver under POL-RD-08. The driver is nonetheless excused under POL-RD-03. EV-ADVIS-00111-01 is an LTA DataMall closure of the PIE towards Tuas after Clementi Rd — a segment the booked optimal route uses (BKE southbound then PIE westbound); it ran 07:10–09:30, bracketing the 07:47:40–08:25:40 trip; and the trace leaves that corridor at Bukit Panjang before the closed stretch and rejoins it on the AYE afterwards. LTA's own diversion published with the advisory is 'via Upper Bukit Timah Rd' — the road the driver took. I do not accept the rider's argument that the rejoin on the AYE defeats limb (c): one-north is not on the PIE, the optimal route must leave the PIE to reach it, and the trace shows the vehicle leaving the corridor before the closed segment and coming back onto the corridor after it — which is precisely the pattern limb (c) describes. The excuse is capped at the lesser of the measured excess and 1.30 × (29.2 − 24.0) + 1.00 = 7.76 km, so the whole 5.98 km is justified and the closure-adjusted optimal is 29.98 km / 37.5 min. On that adjusted route, POL-RD-02 gives recomputed_fare = 3.80 + 0.75 × 29.98 + 0.28 × 37.5 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = 37.585, against charged_total 37.74 on EV-FARE-00111. The refund is 0.155, below the 0.50 de minimis, so no refund issues and the 37.74 charge stands. The rider's alternative figure of 6.74 (6.75 rounded up) is correct arithmetic against the booked route, but the booked route is not the baseline once POL-RD-03 excuses the excess. No pass-through correction is due: tolls_erp is 0.00 and erp_gantries is empty, so POL-RD-09 has nothing to settle. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 (229 fixes at 10 s, no gaps), so it decides the deviation on its own and needs no independent corroboration. No repeat-deviation pattern is engaged, so no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises, and no POL-RD-10 trigger fires. The rider's 'I did not see any closure' is an assertion with no artifact behind it and does not outweigh the LTA advisory; the driver announced the diversion in the chat at 07:54:20 and the rider answered at 07:54:55 without objecting. On this rider-filed dispute, NO_ACTION leaves the charge as it stands: the SGD 37.74 fare is not refunded, and the SGD 8.00 in dispute is neither returned nor written off.

Which baseline governs. The threshold test (POL-RD-01). The distance that governs is the trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km 20.18 km on EV-GPS-00113 — not the rounded 20.2 km convenience copy on the trip record. Against the 19.40 km matched baseline the excess is 0.78 km, or 4.02% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires both that the excess exceed 20% of optimal and that it exceed 0.8 km in absolute terms. 4.02% is far below 20%, and 0.78 km does not exceed the 0.8 km floor. Both limbs fail, so no deviation exists and the outcome POL-RD-01 directs is NO_ACTION, however the trip is characterised. No MATERIAL deviation is anywhere near reached, so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered; for completeness the driver's trailing-90-day figure is deviation_flags_90d 0 against completed_trips_90d 471, so no repeat-deviation pattern could be established on the fields that clause names, and the driver's clean record is otherwise credibility weighting only (POL-GEN-01).

The Hougang leg. The 90-second stop at Hougang Central was the platform-matched co-rider pickup. Under POL-RD-12, distance attributable to collecting a co-rider on a matched pooled itinerary is never a deviation, and it is already inside the 19.40 km quoted baseline. Your pooled route now includes one pickup at Hougang Central before your drop-off. Estimated 19.4 km, 34 min', and the trip only started at 18:47:10. The driver's chat reply at 19:03:15 ('pool booking, picking up the other passenger, app route') is consistent with that. The rider made no route request of any kind, so no rider-instruction exoneration arises and none is needed: POL-RD-04 is unavailable to the driver, not because of any doubt about conduct but because the clause is simply not in play. The driver's conduct is answered: he drove the matched itinerary and is not at fault, and no adverse finding is made against him.

Money. POL-RD-02 converts an established deviation into a refund and does not run where no deviation is established, so the recomputation is never reached. The fare arithmetic confirms there is nothing else to correct: erp_lines carries no entries (total 0.00), there is no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), the 3.00 pool discount has already been subtracted, and the residual comparison on EV-FARE-00113 (charged_total 26.83; recomputed_fare 25.67; difference before rounding 1.16, payable 1.20) is unreachable because the POL-RD-01 gate fails. No billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) arises from any charge line, so no referral is produced. For the rider's benefit: the 26.83 charged is preserved, and the 6.00 contested amount is not refunded.

Escalation. None of the POL-RD-10 triggers fires. The trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (all TRP-00113); the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07 (100% coverage, 217 fixes at a 10-second interval, gaps empty, max_gap_sec 0.0), so no corroboration question arises; timestamps agree and do not run backwards; no exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing artifact; the refund does not approach SGD 150; the parties' evidence is not in contradiction (both advocates read the same 0.78 km excess); and every charge line has a counterpart. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. The absence of any LTA traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00113-01 is MISSING and could carry no fact at weight 0.0) is noted but is not needed: nothing in this ruling turns on a closure.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: I cannot settle this one on the record, and I am sending it to a human reviewer with the file.

Why it cannot be settled. Your distance claim turns on where this trip actually began. The GPS trace runs 22.40 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km) and, measured whole, shows an excess of 4.80 km over the 17.60 km optimal route — 27.3%, which would clear the POL-RD-01 gate. But the trip record says the trip (the meter) began at 18:32:10 (trip_record.started_at), while the trace's first fix is at 18:18:40 (gps_trace.first_fix_at) — 13 minutes 30 seconds earlier — and the fare (EV-FARE-00112) bills only 20.00 km (distance_charged_km). Measured from the recorded start, the excess is 2.42 km, 13.8%, which fails the same 20% gate. So whether the trace's opening 2.38 km belongs to this trip or is the tail of a previous job decides the deviation, and nothing in the bundle decides that question. If the meter started late the whole trace counts; if the trace carries a previous job the deviation disappears and the billed distance is right.

That is a ground the policy names for escalation. POL-RD-10(4) requires a human reviewer where pickup timestamps on two admitted artifacts disagree by more than ten minutes: the recorded trip start (18:32:10) and the trace's first fix (18:18:40) disagree by 13 minutes 30 seconds. The driver's account that the app was showing the trip as not started is an assertion citing no evidence, so it carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and in any event a contradiction the policy names as its own ground for escalation is not dissolved by an account from either side.

Confidence forces the same result independently. The facts that would decide this case are carried by the trip record and the GPS trace, both admitted at weight_multiplier 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and the 20% threshold straddles the two readings. Confidence is capped at 0.40, below the platform floor of 0.70, so POL-RD-10(1) applies too. The trace is NOT impaired for policy purposes — no gap over 90 seconds, no jump over 500 m, a 10-second sampling interval — so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged; the 0.40 is a POL-GEN-02 confidence discount only, and I am required to say both things.

Where the money would have fallen, so both of you can see it. (1) Even crediting the whole trace, POL-RD-02 recomputes the fare at 25.64: ((3.80 + 0.75 × 17.60 + 0.28 × 28.0) × the 1.0 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP/tolls, against a charged_total of 25.26 — so the refund would be 25.26 − 25.64 = −0.38, floored at zero and below the SGD 0.50 de minimis. The rider's distance claim would yield nothing on the arithmetic alone. (2) The missed Paya Lebar Quarter stop has no monetary remedy in this policy: POL-RD-04 exonerates a driver, it does not pay a rider, and the trace never comes within 200 m of the resolved waypoint (VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER), so the driver's corroboration limb fails in any event. (3) The driver's own claim to SGD 1.80 (2.40 unbilled km × SGD 0.75, under the SGD 15.00 cap) rests on the same disputed opening stretch — the shortfall exists only if the trace's first 2.38 km is this trip — so it is held with everything else rather than paid. (4) No repeat-deviation pattern is established: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d of 296 (ratio 0.0034), far below the POL-RD-06 gates, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. (5) No closure defence arises: the LTA advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00112-01 is MISSING, weight 0.00, so POL-RD-03 cannot be satisfied; and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity finding arises, since erp_gantries is empty and there is no airport surcharge line. (6) No extra corroboration burden attaches to this rider (rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the 4-claim trigger in POL-RD-08).

Escalation is terminal: the contested SGD 6.00 is held, not collected and not refunded, and no money moves in either direction. What would resolve it: the platform's meter/dispatch log or the driver device log showing whether the meter started late or the trace carried the tail of a previous job, plus the platform's stored location pings for the Paya Lebar Quarter waypoint (whether the vehicle ever came within 200 m of it).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To both parties. This was an upfront-quoted trip (fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 34.50 on EV-FARE-00115), which decides most of the case.

THE DISTANCE CLAIM. The rider is right on the facts and wrong on the money. On the governing trace figure (EV-GPS-00115, trace_distance_km 28.18, not the rounded 28.2 on the trip record) the car covered 5.78 km / 25.8% more than the 22.4 km booked optimal, so a deviation IS established under POL-RD-01 (both gates, 20% and 0.8 km, pass). It is not a MATERIAL deviation (needs 50% or 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check was not required on materiality; I ran it anyway and there is no pattern — driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d 523 (0.19%), far below 3 flags or 5%. But under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges on an upfront-quoted trip were fixed at $34.50 at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run, and the rider cannot recover for the extra distance however large the excess is. The driver's attempt to be paid for the detour also fails: POL-RD-04 needs a rider instruction naming a place or road, and the only route message is the driver's own at 21:14:10 ('CTE very heavy boss, i go KPE then TPE'), acknowledged by the rider with 'ok' and a null waypoint_hint. POL-RD-03 fails too — EV-ADVIS-00115-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, no advisory covers CTE/KPE/TPE in the window), so there is no advisory, no validity window and no shortest_lawful_alternative_km, and a bare 'traffic was heavy' does not discharge the driver's burden under POL-RD-08.

THE MONEY. Charged total was $39.00 against the $34.50 quote — a gap of $4.50, and that gap is exactly the two ERP lines (EV-FARE-00115). One of them stands: KPE (Defu Flyover towards ECP) at $2.50, on the optimal route, with the trace passing within 44.5 m at 21:32:40, inside the 250 m crossing radius, so it is properly chargeable. The other does not: 'AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas)' at $2.00, not on the optimal route, and the closest the trace ever comes to that gantry is 5,419 m — sixteen times the match radius. That is a phantom billing line, refunded in full as a standalone correction under POL-RD-09(4), which is available whether or not a deviation exists. Nothing in the clauses produces a referral, so the referral list is empty. The rider's $4.00 is returned and the driver's $2.00 is paid by the platform.

It is down-weighted and cannot alone support a ruling, but it does not carry the deciding fact — the 236-second dwell comes from EV-GPS-00209 and EV-TRIP-00209, both complete at weight 1.0 — so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and I set confidence at 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. ruling.explanation:
The dispute is the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider at Changi T1. The fee itself is in order: EV-FARE-00210 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee_schedule resolution rule (the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and payment_status is PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. But I cannot decide whether that fee stands or is refunded on this record, and I am sending the case to a human reviewer. The SGD 6.00 is held: not collected from the rider and not refunded.

The fee requires all four limbs of POL-NS-01. Two are satisfied on the trip record: there is a driver 'arrived' event at 23:42:10, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes limb (d) recognises. The other two limbs turn on the GPS trace, and that is where the case breaks down.

EV-GPS-00210 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a) and (b): its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (the limit is 90), and it loses a 186-second sampling gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 that sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry. Its weight is 0.25 and its issue codes are CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD. Read at face value the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 404 seconds, 76 seconds short of the 480-second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-01(c) requires. Corrected for the 228-second skew the same fix falls at 23:38:33 server time and the dwell is 632 seconds, comfortably over. The gap conceals the one fact that would choose between them, so limb (c) is undecided and limb (b) cannot be verified either, because no fix can be safely matched to the 23:42:10 arrival event.

The trip record EV-TRIP-00210 is also impaired, at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT: its arrived_at of 23:42:10 and its implied 6.9-minute (415-second) wait cannot be reconciled with the trace. Two admitted artifacts therefore contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell, and no clause resolves the conflict.

On the parties' competing claims: the rider's case that the 6.9-minute window (415 seconds, from the arrival tap to cancellation) falls 65 seconds short reads the tap, but POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and once the skew is allowed for the same trace yields 632 seconds, so the shortfall is not proved. The driver's case that the corrected 632 seconds puts him over the minimum is equally unprovable, because the 186-second gap hides the entry moment. The accumulated-dwell route under POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable: EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, and the limb requires a present, populated advisory. On POL-NS-02 the driver's closest approach of 96 m is inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius with 5 qualifying fixes, so proximity is met on the face of the trace, but that only turns the dispute to dwell, which is undecided.

The driver's compensation claim under POL-NS-07 (SGD 4.80, being 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee) fails because POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, which it is not. The anti-farming check does not trip - no_show_terminations_30d of 2 is below 4 and 2/156 = 0.013 is below 0.08 - so no abuse finding and no packet from that branch. On the rider's exoneration routes: POL-NS-04 does not apply, because the only surviving rider message ('why cancel?? i was at door 6') was sent at 23:49:40, after the 23:49:05 cancellation, so limb (a) fails, and limb (c) is undecidable because the trace carries no rider_track (PARTIAL_RECORD), which is neutral rather than adverse. POL-NS-05 cannot be run at all while the 228-second skew makes the arrival marker unmatchable, so no false-arrival finding is entered. POL-NS-03 is not engaged, the driver's fixes sitting inside the 150 m radius.

Confidence is capped at 0.25, the weight of the sole artifact (the GPS trace) that carries the dwell under POL-NS-01(c), far below the 0.70 floor. Escalation is triggered three ways: POL-NS-09(b) (two admitted artifacts contradict on arrival and dwell, unresolved by any clause), POL-NS-09(e) (the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b)), and POL-NS-09(a) (confidence below the floor). No referral is issued: POL-NS-05(ii) cannot fire because the clause cannot be run, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch has not tripped. The open question for the reviewer is when the driver actually entered the geofence - whether the 228-second device skew should be corrected (632 seconds, fee chargeable) or not (404 seconds, fee refundable) - and whether the 186-second gap conceals an entry before 23:42:10.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

The cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 cannot stand and is refunded to the rider in full. Both Advocates' surviving claims are answered below.

ARRIVAL — POL-NS-01(b) read with POL-NS-02. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and needs all four limbs. Limbs (a) and (d) are met: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:12:35, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 08:20:30 with cancellation_reason_code EXCESSIVE_WAIT, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. Limb (b) is not met. POL-NS-02 deems arrival only where the trace holds at least 3 consecutive fixes each reporting horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. EV-GPS-00212 is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with 100% coverage, zero gaps and 93 driver fixes, yet its derived facts record qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds: every reading failed the 25 m filter, so there is no admissible arrival. The clause states in terms that fixes worse than 25 m are ignored and 'count as evidence of neither presence nor absence', and that where no qualifying in-radius fix exists the driver never arrived and the fee is refunded in full. The driver's argument that the closest reported approach was 37.94 m (inside the 50 m radius) therefore does not assist him — on the clause's own test that reading is inadmissible, and limb (b)'s failure is decisive. POL-NS-03 does not give the driver a route back either: there is no established stationary hold outside the arrival radius within 400 m, and the rider named the correct entrance ('exit A') in chat, so limb (i) would place the loss on the driver in any event.

DWELL — POL-NS-06. Independently, the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (accumulated_dwell run_count 0, shortfall_sec 300.0). POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The only mechanism that could bridge the shortfall, limb (i), is unavailable: EV-ADVIS-00212-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with a BLOCKING MISSING_ARTIFACT issue, and the clause says a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable. The rider's own track (60 fixes, all stationary, worst case 40.37 m from the pin) is consistent with her standing at the kerb she named, though every one of her fixes also fails the 25 m filter and is neutral rather than proof of presence; it does not bear on the driver's arrival.

ESCALATION. The driver's alternative request for escalation under POL-NS-09(b) fails. The GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and is not impaired under any limb of POL-NS-08 (no clock skew beyond 90 s, no gap over 120 s, chat intact at 4 messages matching chat_message_count, and the 4.00 fee reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule, difference 0.00). The accuracy filter resolves the location question by the clause's own test rather than leaving two admissible artifacts in direct, unresolved conflict, so there is no POL-NS-09(b) trigger, and no POL-NS-09(e) trigger because the deciding artifact is not impaired. POL-NS-08's own note confirms that poor horizontal accuracy is data and not a defect, and that schema-level tags do not escalate a case the policy considers decidable.

COMPENSATION. Driver compensation under POL-NS-07 is not payable: it requires POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, and the fee is displaced by POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 2 against completed_trips_30d 132, 1.5%, below both thresholds), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. I have not relied on rating, acceptance_rate, prior_no_show_flags or any other context-only profile field; the driver's own citation of those counters as context only is noted and nothing adverse is built on them. POL-NS-04 does not apply (the driver replied 28 seconds after the rider's locating message) and POL-NS-05 is not engaged (no derived fact places the driver over 300 m from the pin or in motion at 15 km/h or above at the arrival timestamp), so no false-arrival referral arises.

AMOUNT. The fare breakdown itemises a cancellation fee of 4.00, the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00), with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. No booking or platform fee is refunded because none was charged. The whole 4.00 cessation charge is returned to the rider, and no sum is payable to the driver. Confidence is 0.85; the deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-00212 at weight_multiplier 1.0 and by the trip and chat records also at 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Both of you agree on the money, so the amount is not in dispute: EV-FARE-00211 (weight 1.0) shows a single $4.00 cancellation-fee line charged, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and no booking or platform fee on a cancelled trip. $4.00 is the correct figure under the fee schedule because the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee are both $4.00 (the greater-of rule yields 4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

The case turns on one thing: whether the driver served five continuous minutes (300 s) inside the 50 m pickup radius, measured from his first qualifying in-geofence fix (POL-NS-01(c), POL-NS-02). The platform trip record (EV-TRIP-00211, weight 1.0) puts the arrival marker at 12:29:55 and the driver's cancellation at 12:38:20, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00211) places the driver 18.1 m from the pin, inside the radius, both before and after the wait, at 6.1–11.9 m accuracy. But the trace is impaired: weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE. A 168-second outage runs from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28, inside the waiting window and over the 120-second trace-defect limb in POL-NS-08(b), so it is a policy impairment and not only a schema tag, and coverage is 84.3%.

On the fixes that are present, the driver's longest unbroken in-geofence run is 220 s (12:30:00 to 12:33:40), with a second run of 112 s (12:36:28 to 12:38:20). Two hundred and twenty seconds is short of 300, and the two runs may not be added together: the accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) requires a present and populated traffic advisory of an admissible type, and EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0). So the driver's five minutes are not established. Nor are they disproved: across the 168 unobserved seconds the trace cannot show whether he stayed at the kerb or left and returned, so the continuous-dwell limb is UNDECIDED over that stretch, and an undecided limb supports neither the fee (which needs limb (c) to hold) nor the full refund (which needs it to fail).

DRIVER: Limbs (a) and (b) hold (arrival event 12:29:55; in-radius fixes at 18.1 m inside the 25 m accuracy filter), limb (d) holds (no boarding; driver termination at 12:38:20 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW), there is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05, and POL-NS-03 is not engaged (fixes are inside the 50 m radius and registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more). Your claim that the weight-1.0 trip record independently proves the hold is rejected: POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying GPS fix and expressly not from the 'arrived' event, so the record's 8.4-minute wait_time cannot carry limb (c). Your 500-second 'longest qualifying run' straddles the outage and so cannot establish the CONTINUOUS presence the limb demands. Your 12:35:10 message, 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you', does not prove where the vehicle was, so it does not decide limb (c) for you; but it is a contemporaneous message sent from inside the unobserved stretch, lying between GPS readings the trace did admit, so it is a bridging record: it stops the impaired trace from being the only evidence of the deciding fact and sets the confidence cap at the higher of the two independent carriers, not at 0.39. It does not lift the outcome to a driver win.

RIDER: POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: you messaged at 12:31:02 and the driver replied at 12:31:20, 18 seconds later, so limb (b) (no reply within 120 seconds) fails and the clause does not apply whatever the reply said. Your shortfall point is well taken, but the very gap that produces the shortfall also leaves the question open, so it yields a split rather than the full $4.00 you seek; and a gap in the driver's own evidence does not by itself prove the dwell fell short. Your closest approach of 24.6 m is accepted and does not change the arithmetic.

Because the required five continuous minutes are neither established nor disproved, and because the impaired trace is not the sole evidence for that fact, the disputed $4.00 fee is split: $2.00 is refunded to the rider and the remaining $2.00 stands. No driver compensation is payable, because POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full and limb (c) is not. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case cannot be decided on the record, so the SGD 6.00 no-show fee is neither collected from the rider nor refunded to her — it stays on hold exactly where it already is (fare_breakdown.payment_status is PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The case goes to a human reviewer under POL-NS-09. To the driver: your trip record is complete and unimpaired at weight 1.0 and proves two of the four things POL-NS-01 requires — a recorded arrival event at 2026-08-11T17:47:05 (limb (a)) and a termination at 17:53:40 under RIDER_UNREACHABLE, one of the three codes limb (d) accepts. I also accept that the SGD 6.00 reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (the greater of the SGD 6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (3 no-show terminations against 107 completed trips, 2.8 percent, below both the count of 4 and the rate of 0.08). But limbs (b) and (c) turn on the GPS trace, and EV-GPS-00213 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-NS-01(c) measures the required 300-second hold from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap, so the record's own 6.6-minute wait and the 395 seconds from arrival to cancellation cannot establish the in-geofence dwell. Your arrival is therefore unproven, POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, and the SGD 4.80 compensation POL-NS-07 would pay (80 percent of SGD 6.00) is not payable. Your account of being at the bay from about 17:47 to 17:53 is noted, but a counterparty statement carries no weight multiplier and POL-NS-01(b) and (c) read the trace, not a party's word. To the rider: none of your refund routes runs on this bundle. POL-NS-02 (no qualifying in-radius fix), POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) and POL-NS-06 (dwell short of the minimum) each need the GPS trace to show what happened, and there is no trace to read; POL-NS-04 needs the chat log, and EV-CHAT-00213 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT although the trip record counts 3 messages. The absence of an artifact is not an artifact showing the driver was elsewhere, so no refund can be found on those clauses either, and no POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral arises because that clause cannot be run without a fix. What decides the case is POL-NS-09, on two grounds. (c): rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 2 — two or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days, a third round a single-case view cannot fairly settle. (a): the fact that decides the fee — whether the driver entered the Jurong East geofence and held it — is carried by no admissible artifact, the only candidate being the MISSING trace at weight 0.0, so confidence sits below the 0.70 floor. Escalation is terminal: no money moves, and no SGD 3.00 pin-ambiguity goodwill or other payment issues. Open question for the reviewer: whether the driver actually entered the Jurong East pickup geofence and stayed within it for the 300-second minimum, which the missing GPS trace and the missing chat log prevent this tribunal from determining. That is a question for the reviewer, not a clause-mandated referral, so the referrals list is empty.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Your $4.00 no-show cancellation fee stands and is not refunded, and the driver is paid $3.20 (80% of that $4.00 fee) by the platform.

Why the fee stands. The fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 300 seconds - the minimum for a LARGE_VENUE pickup. You are right that the driver's own 10-second GPS trace (EV-GPS-00214) shows two separate holds - 170 seconds from 18:44:45 and 185 seconds from 18:49:35 - and neither alone reaches 300 seconds. But POL-NS-06(i) permits the two in-geofence intervals to be counted together where the driver circled a restricted kerb and never strayed more than 300 m from the pin. Both conditions are met on this record: the LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-00214-01 carries type KERB_RESTRICTION, covers the pickup road and is in force 17:00-20:00, over the whole 18:38-18:52 window; and the driver's furthest point between the two holds was 179.0 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash. The larger 1,191.8 m figure in the trace is the driver's approach to Orchard before he reached the bay at all, not a position during the pickup attempt, so it does not break the leash. Added together the dwell is 355 seconds, 55 seconds above the required minimum, so POL-NS-06 yields no refund.

On the arrival marker: the driver tapped 'arrived' at 18:44:30, 15 seconds before the first in-geofence fix at 18:44:45. That is within one sampling interval, and it is not a false arrival - the driver was not more than 300 m away and not travelling at 15 km/h or more. Under POL-NS-05(iii) the waiting clock is recomputed to run from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:44:45, and because the corrected dwell of 355 seconds still exceeds the 300 second minimum, the marker does not defeat the fee.

The other refund routes do not apply. POL-NS-04 fails: the driver replied to your 18:46:20 message at 18:47:50, 90 seconds later, inside the 120-second window, and in any event your device remained 691-717 m from the pin with no qualifying fix inside the 150 m rider-presence radius. POL-NS-03 does not apply because ION Orchard has a single registered pickup point and the driver's holds were inside the 120 m arrival radius. Your assertion that the driver 'never even stayed 5 minutes in one place' misdescribes the test, which expressly permits the intervals to be summed.

Money and checks. The $4.00 charged reconciles: it is the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee ($4.00), so there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d). Driver compensation is 80% of the $4.00 fee, i.e. $3.20 (POL-NS-07); the anti-farming check does not trip because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2 of 118 completed trips is 0.017 (below 0.08). No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger applies: the trip record and GPS trace agree on arrival and cancellation, every artifact in the bundle is complete at weight 1.0, so no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence, the two parties share no prior no-show dispute in the trailing 90 days, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1. The driver's $3.20 is platform-funded and never netted against your fee.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider: on the merits of this trip the record is against you, and your demand for the SGD 4.00 back is not supported. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00207 (weight 1.0, 100% coverage, no gaps) places the driver inside the 50 m arrival radius for Blk 682 Woodlands Ave 6 from 06:41:10 continuously to the cancellation at 06:49:37 — a single unbroken 507-second hold, 207 seconds longer than the 300-second minimum the fee schedule requires for a STANDARD pickup. The trip record EV-TRIP-00207 (weight 1.0) records the arrival event at 06:41:20, the driver's termination at 06:49:37 with reason RIDER_NO_SHOW, and no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore met, POL-NS-02 confirms the driver was inside the geofence, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee (the driver was 14.5 m from the pin when he marked arrival, so POL-NS-05 raises no false-arrival point; there is no shortfall for POL-NS-06; and this was not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03). The record does not corroborate that you came down: your own device's track in EV-GPS-00207 sits about 1.9 km from the pin for the entire waiting window with no qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, and no message in the chat log EV-CHAT-00207 (weight 1.0) was sent by you, while the driver both messaged at 06:42:30 and placed an unanswered in-app call at 06:45:10 — so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you either. To the driver: you met every condition the fee depends on, and the amount reconciles with the schedule — the GREATER of the SGD 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, matching the cancellation_fee line in EV-FARE-00207 (weight 1.0). But POL-NS-07's anti-farming check reads your own trailing-30-day numbers on EV-DPROF-00207 (weight 1.0): 7 no-show terminations against 61 completed trips, a rate of 11.5%. That is both 4-or-more and greater than 0.08, so both limbs are met, your compensation is WITHHELD and the case must go to a human reviewer under POL-NS-09(d). This is a pattern check on your last 30 days, not a finding that this trip was fabricated — on this trip the record is with you. Outcome: the case is ESCALATED and no money moves now. The disputed SGD 4.00 is neither collected nor refunded; EV-FARE-00207 shows payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and charged_at null, so the fee stays on hold while review is pending. Your SGD 3.20 compensation (80% of SGD 4.00) is not paid. Per POL-NS-07 the reviewer is directed to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full if the escalation resolves in the rider's favour. The riders' and driver's remaining claims on the same points are answered together above: both sides' POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 claims are accepted, both sides' POL-NS-07 anti-farming and POL-NS-09(d) claims are accepted and are what decide this case, and the rider's point that the fee is held rather than collected is accepted. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is disclosed but carries no fact and is needed by no clause here, since the dwell already exceeds the minimum without accumulation. The profile fields rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate, prior_disputes_filed, prior_no_show_flags and the like were raised only to be disclaimed as context-only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as any ground of decision.
